full_judgment:
Kazi Ebadul Hoque J: Plaintiff-petitioners seek leave to appeal from judgment and decree dated 10-6-1998 passed by a Division Bench of the High Court Division in First Appeal No. 113 of 1996 allowing the appeal and reversing the judgment and decree dated 17-5-1994 passed by the learned Subordinate Judge, First Court, Chittagong in Partition Suit No. 37 of 1986. 

 3. Trial Court by judgment dated 17-5-1994 decreed the suit for partition in preliminary form. Being aggrieved by the same defendant-respondent Nos. 1 and 2 filed the aforesaid first appeal before the High Court Division. By the impugned judgment High Court Division allowed the appeal and dismissed the suit. Being aggrieved by the same petitioners have filed this petition for leave to appeal. 

 4. Learned Advocate for the petitioners submits that preliminary decree was passed on 17-5-1994 and respondent Nos. 1 and 2 filed FAT No. 41 of 1995 against the preliminary decree on 15-1-1995 but the memo of appeal was taken back by the said appellants on 22-2-1995. Thereafter on 29-11-1995 final decree was passed by the trial Court and the same was put into execution on 20-1-1996 in Execution Case No.3 of 1996. Thereafter, on 9-4-1996 memo of appeal against the preliminary decree was refiled with an application for condonation of delay of 85 days only though the delay was much more that 85 days. Thereafter, on 9-5-1996 execution was completed by delivery of possession to the petitioners and, as such, the first appeal against the preliminary decree was not maintainable. He further submits that the memorandum of appeal refilled on 9-4-1996 was barred by delay of much more than 85 days and, as such, condonation of the delay of 85 days was not legal.
